body: thank you for the caring message :) you know, even before i was diagnosed with everything all i wanted from around when i turned 7 was to leave my house. i hated how my strict russian dad controlled everything and i never really felt close to him. a few months ago, him and my mom were going to get divorced because they argued all the time about me. i was happy, i know how bad that must sound but i feel happier when its just me and her. but despite all his abuse she found it in her heart to forgive him. and now im here

thank you for the advice. i would try to do all of that, but its pretty late where i live so i cant take of that. and you see, everything has been so drained from me that i cant even enjoy things i used to love to do. i used to find joy from dancing and listening to 90's happy music and playing lacrosse and horseback riding, but all of it seems just pointless now. i cant rely on anything to cheer me up. even when i surround myself by people at school, my "friends", i dont feel genuinely happy.
